summary: Iteration 45: Backend-only testing of Export Endpoints and Migrated APIs. All 23 tests passed. Verified CSV/JSON export functionality for assessorias, graph data export, ranking-corridas migration, and feed reactions system.

minor.issue: Invalid format parameter (e.g., xml) defaults to CSV instead of returning 422 validation error
Return 403 Forbidden instead of 401 Unauthorized when no auth provided - minor semantic difference, functionality works correctly

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ CSV export uses UTF-8 BOM (utf-8-sig) for Excel compatibility
✅ JSON export returns properly structured data with atletas, corridas, and estatisticas
✅ Export endpoints require authentication (admin, super_admin, or dono_assessoria)
✅ dono_assessoria users can only export their own assessoria data
✅ Graph export endpoint includes metadados with exportado_por and data_exportacao
✅ Content-Disposition headers correctly set for file downloads
✅ ranking-corridas endpoints migrated and working (nacional/estadual filtering)
✅ liga-assessorias/estados returns distinct states with assessorias
✅ feed/reacoes-disponiveis returns all 7 reaction types with correct emojis
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing Maratona Club RJ assessoria
context_for_next_testing_agent: All export endpoints verified working. CSV returns UTF-8 BOM encoded file, JSON returns structured data with atletas/corridas/estatisticas. Auth endpoints return 403 instead of 401 when unauthenticated. server.py reduced from 4347 to 3421 lines after refactoring.
